verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official GitLab CLI documented at docs.gitlab.com/editor_extensions/gitlab_cli/. GitLab's own docs also state that Duo Chat is available in the GitLab Duo CLI, an AI-oriented first-party command-line surface. Third-party partner CLIs such as Kilo and OpenCode do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's commands and agentic capabilities (e.g. scripting or automation by AI agents), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
